2607.15053.title: ANet Patu-1: The Value of Connection in the Agent Network
2607.15053.paper_summary: The Internet taught us that the value of a network depends on \emph{how} its nodes connect: broadcast stars scale as $V\!\propto\!N$ (Sarnoff), fully-connected meshes as $N^2$ (Metcalfe), and group-forming networks as $2^{N}$ (Reed). We ask the analogous question for networks of AI agents. We model the net value of connection as a function of coordination-group size, derive from it the properties an optimal collaboration protocol must have, and introduce ANet Patu-1 -- a self-organizing consensus protocol in which the network continuously re-forms its own coalitions, adaptively riding the upper envelope of all three regimes at $O(1)$ parallel consensus rounds. To measure value without opinion-grading, we score an emergent protocol by formally specifying it and deriving its complexity, the way distributed algorithms are analyzed. Two results follow. (i)~Emergence -- a crowd of the \emph{cheapest} model, when heterogeneous, starts weak but its collective value compounds with $N$ and \emph{overtakes} a crowd of a far \emph{stronger} model that is homogeneous: a crossover that marks a scaling law for collaboration rather than for scale. (ii)~Reflexivity -- a heterogeneous network, given only its own problem and no design hints, converges on ANet Patu-1 itself, reconstructing the high-dimensional law that governs its own connective value.
2607.15053.paper_summary_zh: 網際網路教會我們，網絡的價值取決於其節點如何連接：廣播星的規模為 $V\!\propto\!N$（Sarnoff），完全連接的網格為 $N^2$（Metcalfe），而形成群體的網絡為 $2^{N}$（Reed）。我們對 AI 代理的網絡提出類似的問題。我們將連接的淨值建模為協調小組大小的函數，從中推導出最佳協作協議必須具備的特性，並介紹 ANet Patu-1——一種自組織共識協議，其中網絡不斷重新形成自己的聯盟，適應性地在 $O(1)$ 個平行共識回合中騎乘所有三種模式的上包絡線。為了在不進行意見評分的情況下衡量價值，我們通過正式規範一個新興協議並推導其複雜性來進行評分，這與分佈式算法的分析方式相同。隨之而來兩個結果。(i)~新興性——當異質的 \emph{最便宜} 模型的群體開始時較弱，但其集體價值隨著 $N$ 增加而累積，並 \emph{超越} 一個同質的、遠 \emph{更強} 模型的群體：這是一個標誌著協作的規模法則，而非僅僅是規模的交叉點。(ii)~反身性——一個異質網絡，僅給定其自身問題而沒有設計提示，最終會收斂到 ANet Patu-1 本身，重建統治其自身連接價值的高維法則。
